Definition: an Ashurite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashur, a district in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ashurites = "guided: blessed"; adj; 1) a tribe inhabiting the plain of Esdraelon; Asshuri = "steps"; n pr m; 2) a tribe descended from Abraham and Keturah
